name: jarvis-gateway-config
description: Jarvis-local configuration for the mcp-hot-gateway daemon. The gateway ITSELF lives in ~/Projects/mcp-hot-gateway (published as mcp-hot-gateway) — this directory holds only what is specific to this machine: the child roster (gateway-config.json), its secrets (.env), the launchd job, and introspect.mjs (used by the router dashboard, not part of the gateway).
